row.evidence: Broadcom's Tanzu UAA docs say UAA supports SCIM and that the scim.write scope "gives admin write access to all SCIM endpoints, /Users , and /Groups"; Tanzu Platform is sold only through Contact Sales.
row.notes: Quote-only: Tanzu Platform (now sold by Broadcom) has no public pricing; the product page offers only Contact Sales. It is a self-managed private-cloud PaaS whose identity server, Tanzu UAA, exposes SCIM /Users and /Groups endpoints protected by OAuth scopes. Broadcom does not document an IdP provisioning connector, SCIM version or deprovisioning behaviour; SAML/OIDC/LDAP users are created as shadow users on first login, and bulk import uses the cf-mgmt tool. idp entries are left null because no IdP-specific provisioning guide exists. Researched the Elastic Application Runtime (Cloud Foundry) and Tanzu Hub docs, v10.4.

plans.name: VMware Tanzu Platform
plans.notes: No public tier table; the product page offers only Contact Sales. Self-managed private-cloud PaaS.

auth.token_source: UAA OAuth client token carrying scim.read / scim.write / scim.create scopes (e.g. uaac token client get admin)

roles.how: Platform admin rights are UAA groups (scim.read, scim.write, cloud_controller.admin) that can be mapped from SAML, OIDC or LDAP groups; org and space roles are set separately with cf set-org-role / cf set-space-role.

limitations.text: The SCIM endpoints are Tanzu UAA's own /Users and /Groups API, documented only through OAuth scopes; Broadcom documents no IdP (Okta, Entra) provisioning connector, SCIM version or base URL for it.
Self-managed product: UAA runs inside the customer's own Tanzu deployment, so there is no vendor-hosted tenant SCIM URL.

capabilities.notes: Users are created through UAA (/Users, cf create-user) and invited through /invite_users; org/space roles are assigned with the cf CLI (Cloud Controller API). HTTP methods for UAA user endpoints other than POST /Users are not shown on Broadcom's pages.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP identity provider in UAA; bulk import of SAML/LDAP users with the cf-mgmt tool
fallbacks.notes: jit_protocol 'both': UAA creates shadow users for SAML and OIDC (and LDAP) sign-ins.

citations.title: Tanzu UAA overview

citations.title: Tanzu UAA scopes
citations.quote: scim.write This scope gives admin write access to all SCIM endpoints, /Users , and /Groups .

citations.title: Tanzu UAA scopes
citations.quote: scim.create This scope gives the ability to create a user with a POST request to the /Users endpoint, but not to modify, read, or delete users.

citations.title: Tanzu UAA scopes
citations.quote: scim.invite This scope is required to participate in invitations using the /invite_users endpoint.

open_questions: SCIM version, base URL and filtering/pagination of the UAA /Users endpoint are not shown on Broadcom's pages (UAA API reference is on docs.cloudfoundry.org, not a Broadcom domain).
Whether Okta/Entra SCIM clients can provision into UAA is not documented.
Deprovisioning behaviour (delete vs deactivate) through UAA SCIM is not documented on Broadcom's pages.
No public pricing or licensing metric.
Audit-log API and user-event webhooks not researched/documented.
